_doc: Shared input card for the Claude-track intermediate-scale passes (from Pass 12707). Scripts should load values from here instead of hard-coding them. Sources checked 2026-11-23.

Mt.source: PDG 2024 average (the repo's historical central value)
Mt.sigma_scheme_note: MC-mass vs pole/MSR interpretation; pole renormalon floor ~0.25 GeV (Hoang-Lepenik-Preisser 2017), O(0.5-1) GeV MC calibration (Hoang 2014 review). Not included in passes 12684-12706.

M_VL_floor_GeV.source: Pass 12693 (prompt); 1900 long-lived (Pass 12697). Pass 12704's B band used 1650 (drift).

FCC_era.note: FCC-ee threshold scan incl. theory; FCC-hh y' from Pass 12698 (0.002) and Pass 12705 (0.005)

dark_dimension.source: Langhoff arXiv:2610.01825 (v1 preprint, Oct 2026): KK-graviton DM excluded in a flat dark dimension; MeV gamma rays + T_RH >= 5.96 MeV need R <~ 0.2 um. Same threshold suppression: Lee-Randall-Riojas (arXiv 2609.36234 as cited).
